detail: From the SP-050 security audit (0 critical/high/medium). Accepted: (1) the walk lists folders through an os.Root, but each checkout is read by absolute path with handoff.CheckoutAt, which follows a linked worktree's .git pointer outside the chosen folder by design; a folder swapped for a symlink between listing and reading could make it read one .git outside the folder. Only that remote's owner/repo reaches the operator. (2) The one-scan-at-a-time slot is a package variable, shared by every server in the process (one per orchd). (3) gh profile checks have no single-flight: a scan and a Status call at the same moment can each start a gh auth check for the same profile. (4) A placement or gh error is returned to the operator verbatim (no terms or tokens).
